documentation.remarks: PayloadBytes is byte-based because JsonElement is not a stable DataContractSerializer payload for DAPR actor remoting. Future members must be additive to preserve actor wire compatibility. The projection actor proxy invokes this type over the System.Text.Json (weak) actor path, so exactly one constructor is annotated with JsonConstructorAttribute to keep deserialization unambiguous (a second unannotated public constructor makes System.Text.Json throw).
